UnitStatement: design_workspace/engine.py provides deterministic design-authoring and comparison workspace records for DEL-07-08.

The design workspace is a GUI-facing composition layer that consumes already-available contract records and returns inspectable panel state; it does not mutate accepted model state, execute solvers, or turn comparison output into professional acceptance.
WORKSPACE_VERSION constant is '0.1.0' for the design workspace schema.
PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY requires human review and disclaims software compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims.

DATA_BOUNDARY policy: public examples use invented or cleared data only; no bundled protected owner/standards data; private data by references and redacted metadata only; unit-bearing values require explicit unit metadata.

build_design_authoring_comparison_workspace builds a deterministic GUI workspace record from upstream contracts keyed by workspace_id with optional design knowledge, constraint validation, warnings, model states, analysis runs, comparisons, tolerance profile, operation preview/audit, and selected refs.
The workspace record carries deliverable_id DEL-07-08, package_id PKG-07, scope_item SOW-076, and objectives OBJ-015 and OBJ-016.

Workspace mutation_boundary asserts the workspace does not mutate accepted model state, has no hidden mutation, routes GUI-originated changes only through structured operation or application-service command intents, and requires an explicit user acceptance record for accepted operations.
build_design_authoring_comparison_workspace computes a workspace_hash over composition panels via _hash_payload.
canonical_json serializes workspace records with stable key ordering using sorted keys, compact separators, and ASCII escaping.
_design_knowledge_panel composes the design knowledge panel, emitting a WORKSPACE-DESIGN-KNOWLEDGE-MISSING warning and unavailable_missing_input panel when input is absent.
_design_record normalizes a design knowledge record, emitting WORKSPACE-DESIGN-RECORD-NOT-OBJECT (blocking) when the record is not a structured object.
A design record's unresolved_assumption_ids are assumption ids whose status is 'unresolved' or 'TBD'.
_constraint_warning_panel composes constraint validation and warning UX contract output, emitting warnings when either input is unavailable.
The constraint warning panel marks has_blocking when validation reports has_blocking_findings or any diagnostic/warning has blocking severity.
_state_run_browser builds model-state and analysis-run browser rows and emits WORKSPACE-MODEL-STATES-MISSING / WORKSPACE-ANALYSIS-RUNS-MISSING warnings when empty.
_model_state_browser_row builds a deterministic model-state browser row capturing state ref, kind, analysis status, hashes, hash boundary, immutability, and review/privacy classification.
Model-state immutability defaults to snapshot_is_read_only True with mutation_policy 'changes_create_new_model_state'.
_analysis_run_browser_row builds a deterministic analysis-run browser row capturing run ref, kind, model-state ref, result refs, analysis status, diagnostics, and hash boundary.
_state_run_hash_boundary records DEL-02-05 hash evidence per state/run row and emits WORKSPACE-MODEL-STATE-HASH-MISSING / WORKSPACE-ANALYSIS-RUN-HASH-MISSING warnings for rows lacking hashes.
Human acceptance is invalidated because hash-bound external records do not survive a payload-hash change; workspace hash scope is ui_composition_review_state_only.
State/run browser inherits PKG-14 model state and analysis run records and PKG-16 operation audit records.
_comparison_tables composes model-state and analysis-run comparison tables plus mapping-contract and tolerance-profile summaries.
_model_comparison_table builds comparison rows and an unmatched_rows subset for added, removed, unresolved, or unresolved-mapping classifications.
_analysis_comparison_table builds analysis result and settings delta rows and reports has_blocking_findings.
_analysis_result_row normalizes a result delta row with mapping id, result family, classification, tolerance refs, unit, dimension, magnitudes, and normalized delta.
_graphical_overlays builds descriptor-only overlays from model comparison, analysis comparison, and operation preview rows; overlay_policy is descriptor_only_no_solver_or_geometry_generation.
_model_overlay produces a model_state_delta overlay; it is visible by default unless classification is unchanged or mapped_unchanged.
_analysis_overlay produces an analysis_result_delta overlay bound to upstream result object refs (descriptor only) with visual review support only.
_operation_overlay produces an operation_diff_preview overlay visible by default only when preview_status is 'previewed'.
_operation_diff_review composes operation diff-preview rows joined with audit records, emitting warnings when preview or audit input is missing.
operation_diff_review operation_policy asserts the workspace does not apply operations, does not mutate accepted state, and requires explicit user acceptance before labelling an accepted operation.
_operation_review_row joins a preview row with its audit decision and emits WORKSPACE-OPERATION-MUTATION-SIGNAL-BLOCKED (blocking) when application_status is not 'not_applied'.
An operation can be represented as an accepted operation only when the audit decision is accepted, has explicit user acceptance, and did not mutate accepted model state.
Operation review rows force workspace_application_status to not_applied and accepted_model_state_mutated_by_workspace to False.

_operation_review_state maps audit decision and preview status to review states: explicit_user_acceptance_recorded, rejected_operation_recorded, held_for_user_acceptance, blocked_by_validation, preview_ready_for_user_review, or preview_unavailable.
_review_state_routing computes route_state as blocked_findings_visible when blocking diagnostics exist, input_unavailable_review when panels are unavailable, else review_navigation_available.
_mapping_contract_summary summarizes a comparison mapping contract with mapping_count and unmatched_count.
_tolerance_profile_summary summarizes a tolerance profile with profile ref, status, and rule_count.
_diagnostic assigns contract_ref DEL-02-05 when the code contains 'HASH', otherwise DEL-02-03.
_contains_tbd recursively detects the literal 'TBD' in strings and treats None values as unresolved TBD.
_hash_payload returns a sha256: prefixed hash over canonical JSON of the value.
editors package exposes material, component, and rule-pack editor contracts for DEL-07-03.
editors/__init__ exports build_editor_contract and canonical_json.
editors/engine.py provides deterministic editor contracts for DEL-07-03.
EDITOR_KINDS are 'material', 'component', and 'rule_pack_reference'.
build_editor_contract builds deterministic material/component/rule-pack editor records keyed by editor_set_id for DEL-07-03 / PKG-07 / SOW-021 / OBJ-006.
Editor contract command_policy is bounded apply/cancel intents only and private_payload_policy keeps references and checksums only with no private payload copy.
_editor_record emits EDITOR_KIND_UNSUPPORTED (blocking) for an unrecognized editor kind and RULE_PACK_CHECKSUM_MISSING (blocking) when a rule_pack_reference lifecycle lacks a checksum.
An editor save_intent has status pending_service_validation and mutates_persistent_project False.
_field_record validates a field, blocking on missing unit/dimension metadata and marking unresolved_TBD when value is None or 'TBD'.
_validation_state returns blocked when no fields, blocked_by_unresolved_fields for unresolved fields, blocked_by_contract_metadata for blocked fields, else ready_for_service_validation.
model_tree package exposes model tree and property inspector contracts for DEL-07-02.
model_tree/__init__ exports GUI_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY, build_model_tree_property_inspector, and canonical_json.
model_tree/engine.py provides deterministic model-tree/property-inspector records for DEL-07-02.
build_model_tree_property_inspector builds a deterministic GUI tree and inspector record from project_id, entities, and an optional selected_ref.
The model-tree function only shapes invented or already-cleared GUI state; it does not mutate project data, persist edits, run solvers, or fill missing values.
Model-tree mutation_policy is application_service_command_intents_only.
_tree_node builds a tree node and emits MODEL_TREE_ENTITY_INCOMPLETE (blocking) for incomplete entities and PROPERTY_VALUE_UNRESOLVED (warning) for unresolved property values.
_selection resolves a selected_ref against known nodes and emits MODEL_TREE_SELECTION_UNKNOWN (warning) when the selection is not present.
_inspector returns the property inspector fields for the resolved selected entity, or no_selection / selection_unresolved when there is no match.
pkg02_boundary.py provides shared PKG-02 boundary helpers for GUI contract records.

CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS enumerates the accepted DEL-02-02 dimension identifiers including dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, pressure, stress, area, volume, density, stiffness, displacement, and TBD.
CANONICAL_ANALYSIS_STATUSES are MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, and HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT.
AUTOMATIC_ANALYSIS_STATUSES are all canonical analysis statuses except HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT.
HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_STATUS is 'HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT'.

unit_contract returns the GUI-facing PKG-02 DEL-02-02 unit contract: canonical dimensions list, retired dimension values forbidden, unit-bearing values require explicit unit metadata, and missing-unit behavior is diagnostic_blocking.

analysis_boundary_contract returns the DEL-02-03 analysis boundary: automatic status scope, human acceptance status, external hash-bound human acceptance authority, software does not emit human approval status, and forbidden software claims (code_compliance, certification, sealing, professional_acceptance, authentication).

persistence_hash_contract returns the DEL-02-05 persistence/hash contract: JCS canonicalization, payload hashes required for persisted or result-available records, and human acceptance invalidates on hash change.
pkg02_diagnostic builds a deterministic diagnostic with PKG-02 envelope-adjacent fields including code, diagnostic_id, severity, target_ref, message, remediation, and contract_ref.
normalize_analysis_statuses validates and normalizes software-emitted analysis statuses against the canonical vocabulary.
normalize_analysis_statuses emits ANALYSIS_STATUS_NON_CANONICAL (blocking) for statuses outside the DEL-02-03 vocabulary.

normalize_analysis_statuses emits ANALYSIS_STATUS_HUMAN_APPROVAL_NOT_SOFTWARE_EMITTED (blocking) because human project acceptance is external and hash-bound and must not be emitted as automatic status.
normalize_analysis_statuses returns statuses sorted by canonical vocabulary order.
quantity_metadata validates explicit unit and dimension metadata for GUI-visible quantities.
quantity_metadata emits a UNIT_METADATA_MISSING blocking diagnostic when a unit-bearing value lacks explicit unit metadata.
quantity_metadata emits a DIMENSION_METADATA_MISSING blocking diagnostic when a unit-bearing value lacks explicit dimension metadata.
quantity_metadata emits a DIMENSION_NON_CANONICAL blocking diagnostic when a dimension is not in the DEL-02-02 vocabulary.
hash_boundary_status summarizes DEL-02-05 hash evidence (presence, count, canonicalization and algorithm values) without interpreting payload contents.

source_of_truth_boundary describes how a GUI surface avoids becoming the canonical data authority: gui_is_source_of_truth is False and the canonical source is the PKG-02 physical_source_of_truth model and governed persistence records.
results_viewer package exposes results viewer contracts for DEL-07-05.
results_viewer/__init__ exports build_results_viewer_contract and canonical_json.
results_viewer/engine.py provides deterministic result-viewer records for DEL-07-05.
RESULT_KINDS are displacement, rotation, force, moment, reaction, stress, and ratio.
build_results_viewer_contract builds deterministic result-view records keyed by result_set_id for DEL-07-05 / PKG-07 / SOW-023.
Results viewer policy is tabular and overlay descriptors only, solver_execution is not_performed, and software makes no professional acceptance claim.
_result_view emits RESULT_KIND_UNSUPPORTED (blocking) for unknown kinds and RESULT_VALUES_MISSING (blocking) when there are no values.
A result view requires canonical analysis status only when its availability is 'available'.
_result_view emits RESULT_HASH_EVIDENCE_MISSING and RESULT_PROVENANCE_REF_MISSING warnings when an available result lacks hashes or provenance refs.
_value_record validates a result value, emitting RESULT_VALUE_NONFINITE (blocking) for non-finite numeric values and RESULT_VALUE_OR_UNIT_UNRESOLVED (warning) for missing value/unit.
solve_execution package exposes solve execution UX contracts for DEL-07-07.
solve_execution/__init__ exports build_solve_execution_ux and canonical_json.
solve_execution/engine.py provides deterministic solve execution UX records for DEL-07-07.
Solve execution VALID_STATES are queued, running, cancelling, cancelled, completed, and failed; TERMINAL_STATES are cancelled, completed, and failed.
build_solve_execution_ux builds a deterministic solve-execution UX timeline keyed by run_panel_id, emitting SOLVE_UX_TERMINAL_STATE_PENDING (warning) when the final state is not terminal.
Solve execution UX records solver_execution as not_performed_by_gui_contract and job_orchestration as invented_state_transitions_only.
_event_record validates a timeline event, emitting SOLVE_UX_STATE_UNSUPPORTED (blocking) for invalid states and SOLVE_UX_PROGRESS_INVALID (blocking) for out-of-range progress.
_event_record emits SOLVE_UX_HASH_EVIDENCE_MISSING and SOLVE_UX_PROVENANCE_REF_MISSING warnings when a result-available event lacks hashes or provenance refs.
_cancellation summarizes cancellation requests and asserts the UX does not mutate the solver process directly.
viewport_editor crate is open_pipe_stress_viewport_editor version 0.1.0 (edition 2021), an unpublished library providing viewport editor command-intent support.
viewport_editor lib.rs models bounded in-memory viewport state for the first centerline-editor slice and prepares deterministic application-service command intents and view primitives.

The viewport editor crate does not render Three.js scenes, parse project files, mutate persisted project payloads directly, access host resources, provide protected engineering data, or make professional/code-compliance claims.
PrimitiveType enum includes Node, PipeRun, BendArc, BranchSymbol, ValveSymbol, FlangeSymbol, ReducerSymbol, ExpansionJointSymbol, SupportSymbol, and Label.
CommandType enum includes CreateNode, ConnectPipeRun, InsertBend, InsertBranchSymbol, InsertComponentSymbol, SelectEntities, and ClearSelection.
ValidationState enum includes Valid, BlockedByMissingData, BlockedByUnitMismatch, and PendingServiceValidation.
DiagnosticClass enum includes SolveBlocking, RuleCheckBlocking, ProvenanceWarning, AssumptionWarning, NonlinearWarning, IpBoundaryWarning, UnitWarning, and GuiStateWarning.
DiagnosticSeverity enum includes Info, Warning, and Blocking.
Tool enum includes Select, CreateNode, ConnectPipeRun, InsertBend, InsertBranchSymbol, InsertComponentSymbol, and PanOrbit.
Point3 is a 3D coordinate struct (x, y, z: f64) with an is_finite check across all components.
Reference is a (ref_type, ref_id) struct; is_complete requires both fields non-empty after trimming.

Provenance struct carries source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status, and privacy_classification; is_complete requires all fields populated.
ProfessionalBoundary struct; project_default sets human_review_required true and all software claim flags false; preserves_boundary verifies that invariant.

ViewportStatus.bounded_contract pins frontend_app_shell, command_transport, and dependency_versions to TBD, with durable state mutation routed through application-service command intents only and transient state not persisted as project payload.

Diagnostic struct carries diagnostic_id, code, class, severity, affected_ref, message, remediation, and provenance; gui_warning builds a GuiStateWarning warning routed through application-service validation before durable mutation.
ViewPrimitive struct carries primitive_id, primitive_type, source_ref, points, unit, diagnostic_refs, and provenance, ordered by (primitive_type, primitive_id).
CommandIntent struct carries intent_id, command_type, target_ref, payload_refs, unit_policy, reversible flag, validation_state, diagnostic_refs, and provenance.
ViewportSession aggregates session_id, model_ref, active_tool, view primitives, selected refs, command intents, diagnostics, and provenance; new() defaults active_tool to Select.
create_node_intent produces a CreateNode command intent with unit_policy 'unit_aware_domain_validation_required', validating point finiteness and unit.
connect_pipe_run_intent requires complete distinct endpoint refs and a complete pipe ref, else emits VIEWPORT_COMMAND_REQUIRES_SERVICE_VALIDATION and BlockedByMissingData.

insert_component_symbol_intent allows only simple symbolic primitives (bend, branch, valve, flange, reducer, expansion joint, support); otherwise emits VIEWPORT_COMPONENT_DATA_MISSING and BlockedByMissingData.
select() filters to complete refs, sorts selected refs deterministically, and produces a non-reversible SelectEntities intent.

is_valid_contract_state requires a non-empty session id, complete model ref and provenance, all command intents carrying the unit-aware validation policy, and complete diagnostic and primitive provenance.
validate_point_intent returns PendingServiceValidation for finite points with an explicit non-TBD unit, otherwise emits VIEWPORT_UNIT_MISMATCH and BlockedByUnitMismatch.

invented_provenance returns the OpenPipeStress invented GUI fixture provenance certifying invented non-engineering interaction data not copied from protected standards, vendor catalogs, or private projects.
Test viewport_status_preserves_bounded_contract asserts the bounded ViewportStatus stays bounded with human review required and no compliance claim.
Test invalid_point_becomes_diagnostic_not_silent_default asserts an invalid point yields a VIEWPORT_UNIT_MISMATCH warning rather than a silent default.
warnings package exposes missing-data warning and blocking UX contracts for DEL-07-04.
warnings/__init__ exports build_warning_ux_contract and canonical_json.
warnings/engine.py provides warning and blocking state contracts for DEL-07-04.
WARNING_CLASSES are solve_required, code_check_required, provenance_missing, assumption, incomplete_data, diagnostic, and professional_boundary.
BLOCKING_CLASSES are solve_required, code_check_required, and incomplete_data.
WARNING_CLASS_STATUS_MAP maps each warning class to its DEL-02-03 analysis statuses (e.g. solve_required -> MODEL_INCOMPLETE, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED).
build_warning_ux_contract builds deterministic warning records keyed by warning_set_id for DEL-07-04 / PKG-07 / SOW-022, with auto_fill_missing_data False and no professional acceptance claim.
_warning_record emits WARNING_CLASS_UNSUPPORTED (blocking) for unknown warning class and WARNING_SOURCE_STATUS_UNRESOLVED (warning) for missing source status outside provenance_missing.
A warning's blocks_progress defaults to whether its class is in BLOCKING_CLASSES.
_severity returns 'blocking' for blocking warning classes, else 'warning', unless an explicit severity is provided.
caepipe_external package provides the CAEPIPE external-run evidence foundation.
caepipe_external/__init__ exports CAEPIPE_EXTERNAL_RUN_VERSION and the build, parse, diagnostics, canonical, and write helpers for external-run packages.
caepipe_external/run.py records deterministic evidence for skipped, parser-only, or user-owned external CAEPIPE run attempts for DEL-17-05.

The CAEPIPE external-run module does not discover, install, bundle, license, or invoke CAEPIPE itself, and does not treat parsed output as compatibility, validation, code-compliance, or professional evidence.
CAEPIPE_EXTERNAL_RUN_VERSION is '0.1.0'.
PACKAGE_STATUSES are skipped_no_executable, parser_only_evidence, external_run_evidence_blocked, and external_run_evidence_recorded.

CAEPIPE PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY supports regression/handoff evidence but disclaims bundling CAEPIPE, invoking it without user configuration, and release/compatibility/solver-validation/compliance/certification/professional-reliance claims.
Default boundary notes state CAEPIPE external execution is optional and user-owned, public tests use skipped or parser-only evidence, and parsed CSV is regression/handoff evidence only.
DEFAULT_PARSER_COVERAGE covers invented public fixture sections NODE_DISPLACEMENTS and ELEMENT_FORCES with parser_only_supported status and diagnostic_warning policy for unmapped rows.
build_skipped_caepipe_external_run_package builds deterministic skip evidence (status skipped_no_executable, not invoked) when no user executable is configured.

build_caepipe_external_run_package builds a deterministic DEL-17-05 CAEPIPE external-run evidence package with normalized config, command profile, run directory, execution result, parser coverage, parsed CSV, diagnostics, and checksums.
parse_caepipe_csv_text parses the invented DEL-17-05 CSV evidence fixture into neutral rows, marking each row correlation_status canonical_id_map or weak_or_unmapped.
parse_caepipe_csv_text emits CAEPIPE-CSV-UNKNOWN-SECTION warnings for sections other than NODE_DISPLACEMENTS or ELEMENT_FORCES.
parse_caepipe_csv_text emits CAEPIPE-CSV-UNMAPPED-ROW warnings for rows not bound to a known canonical stable ID, requiring DEL-17-04 sidecar stable-ID mapping before treating rows as correlated.
parse_caepipe_csv_text emits CAEPIPE-CSV-NO-ROWS (blocking) when no data rows are found.
diagnostics_for_caepipe_external_run_package returns deterministic diagnostics for CAEPIPE external-run evidence.
An external-run package with status outside PACKAGE_STATUSES gets CAEPIPE-RUN-STATUS-UNSUPPORTED (blocking).
External-run evidence missing an MBF package ref gets CAEPIPE-RUN-MBF-REF-MISSING (blocking); a non-DEL-17-04 MBF ref gets CAEPIPE-RUN-MBF-REF-UNSAFE (blocking).
Execution marked attempted without a present user-owned executable path gets CAEPIPE-RUN-EXECUTABLE-NOT-PRESENT (blocking).

Attempted execution without acknowledged license responsibility gets CAEPIPE-RUN-LICENSE-RESPONSIBILITY-MISSING (blocking); without acknowledged environment responsibility gets CAEPIPE-RUN-ENVIRONMENT-RESPONSIBILITY-MISSING (blocking).
A skipped_no_executable package that records an attempted execution gets CAEPIPE-RUN-SKIP-ATTEMPTED (blocking).
A non-skipped external-run package with no parsed CSV rows gets CAEPIPE-RUN-PARSED-ROWS-MISSING (blocking).
Authority wording in command-profile or execution-result free metadata gets CAEPIPE-RUN-AUTHORITY-TERM / CAEPIPE-RUN-RESULT-AUTHORITY-TERM (blocking) via contains_prohibited_authority_term.
canonical_csv normalizes CSV text to ASCII-compatible LF records, trimming trailing whitespace and blank lines.
write_caepipe_external_run_package writes run_metadata, parsed_csv, diagnostics, and checksums JSON members deterministically.
_checksum produces a sha256 JCS-compatible JSON payload hash with payload ref and scope.
_privacy_diagnostics emits CAEPIPE-RUN-PRIVACY-BOUNDARY-VIOLATION (blocking) when private, protected, commercial, or telemetry privacy fields are True.
caepipe_mbf package provides the CAEPIPE MBF export package foundation.
caepipe_mbf/__init__ exports CAEPIPE_MBF_EXPORT_VERSION and the build, render, diagnostics, canonical, and write helpers for MBF export packages.
